rules.description: Cron file owned by root:root is writable by group or other users.
rules.exploit: Modify the writable root-owned cron file and add a command that executes with the privileges of the cron job.

rules.description: Root cron job executes a file from a temporary or shared-memory location.
rules.exploit: Replace the referenced temporary-location executable or script with attacker-controlled content and wait for the root cron job to execute it.

rules.description: Root cron job executes a non-standard application path that should be checked for unprivileged write access.
rules.exploit: Modify the referenced command or one of its writable components if accessible to the current user, then wait for the root cron job to execute it.
